title: DetectionRuleFilter
description: Filters Insikt Notes and the associated detection rules.

types.description: Filters on type of detection rules, applied as a logical "OR". The following values are allowed: `yara`, `sigma`, and `snort`.

entities.description: An array of entities that may be associated with a given detection rule. All values in the array must be valid Recorded Future entity IDs. Use **Entity Match** to lookup entity IDs. Values in this filter are applied as a logical "AND".

created.description: Filters the date range a rule should have been created. The DateTime string should be in a string format, e.g., "2017-07-21T17:32:28Z"

updated.description: Similar to the `created` filter but specifies the date range in which a rule should have been updated. When first created, the update date of a rule is the same as its create date.

doc_id.description: Will look for a specific Insikt Note document ID associated with detection rules

title.description: Filters as a free text search for Insikt Notes associated with detection rules

DetectionRuleType.description:
The type of a Detection Rule Available types:
  * sigma: Sigma rule
  * yara: YARA rule
  * snort: Snort rule
